summary.text: Bonny was a trading city-state of the eastern Delta. Its canoe houses each manned war canoes, some carrying cannon, and fought Kalabari for the trade.

arms.text: Canoe houses manned war canoes, some armed with cannon.
Guns and cannon from the Atlantic trade.

record.text: Civil war split Bonny; Jaja left to found Opobo and took much of the oil trade.

reviewNotes: Arms levels (1 some, 2 a real strength, 3 famous for it) are the compiler’s judgement from the sources, for the Versus page’s guess; please check them.
